Devanagari recognition model: devanagari_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec (PaddleOCR),
exported to ONNX by Wycliffe Associates / docscanner-ocr.
https://huggingface.co/wycliffeassociates/docscanner-ocr
Pinned source revision: 354549cf968c1d8883482a1dc74dde9c762ebf53
Files: devanagari/rec_model.onnx and devanagari/charset.json.
Model and character table: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE).
Model SHA-256: a3d5b5fa34fa3dfc9f3790ee5a28da697ea08b0043d25080d19bf1b9517fa56c
Character table SHA-256: 621d0073b27b8d8ff19629ee7a961f337697f553a29f21c9817057f4359549c3

Experimental for Marathi handwriting. Leafnote validated three rendered Marathi
words with this exact ONNX model in ONNX Runtime Web/WASM, not a handwriting
accuracy benchmark. Always review and correct recognition before saving.

Noto Sans Devanagari font: The Noto Project Authors.
https://github.com/notofonts/devanagari
SIL Open Font License 1.1 (OFL.txt).

Marathi dictionary: unmodified LibreOffice mr_IN/mr_IN.dic.
Source: https://github.com/LibreOffice/dictionaries/tree/e7b61087d7d42eba51425eae74643ea5623c574a/mr_IN
GPL version 2; see dictionary-COPYING. The dictionary is used only to rank
nearby optical readings; it does not generate or force a specified word.
